name: lamp-spec-checks
description: v0.31.5.298 visual verification: the Lamp specification group in the Checks panel. The default flat already has ceiling lights in its bathrooms, so the IP44 and colour-temperature advisories fire out of the box. Pro mode.

steps.name: probe-bathroom-fixtures
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const baths=s.floorPlan.rooms.filter(r=>/bath|wc/i.test(r.name)); const lights=s.items.filter(i=>/light|lamp|sconce|vanity/i.test(i.defId)); window.__probe=JSON.stringify({baths:baths.map(b=>b.name), lightDefs:[...new Set(lights.map(l=>l.defId))]}); })()

steps.name: assert-lamp-spec-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!heads.includes('Lamp specification')) throw new Error('no Lamp specification group — the default flat may have no fixture in a wet room. Section heads: '+heads.join(' | ')); const badges=[...document.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!badges.includes('IP rating')) throw new Error('no IP rating finding. Badges: '+badges.join(' | ')); const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].find(e=>/Lamp specification/.test(e.textContent||'')); h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: assert-lighting-layers-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!heads.includes('Lighting layers')) throw new Error('no Lighting layers group. Heads: '+heads.join(' | ')); const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].find(e=>/Lighting layers/.test(e.textContent||'')); const txt=h.parentElement.textContent||''; if(!/Missing/.test(txt)) throw new Error('group present but names no missing layer'); h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
